notes:
Search can find your writing again. Saving a document was erasing its text from the search index a fraction of a second after writing it, so searching only ever matched titles and synopses — never the prose. In one project 60 of 61 documents could not be found by a phrase they contained. Every affected document is re-indexed automatically the next time the project opens, and a full re-index now includes the text too.

- Fixed a bug that could make Corylus read a document as if it had no title, no synopsis and no identity at all, and then treat it as a different document. Whether it happened depended on where the accented letters fell in the text.
- When a sync replaced your binder structure with the other computer's, the repairs made when the project opened were left behind until the next launch. They are now applied straight away.
- Documents can no longer disappear from the binder while their file sits safely on disk. Affected projects repair themselves on open.
- A document moved into a folder could stop being found by search, because its entry still pointed at the folder it came from.
